items.caption: The Moon drifts about 3.8 cm farther from Earth every year (NASA). We measure it by firing lasers at mirrors the Apollo astronauts left there: the light's round trip takes about 2.5 seconds. Photos: NASA (Apollo 11, 14, 15; Artemis I), NASA/GSFC/Debbie McCallum. No NASA endorsement implied.
